title: Lab Updates (diary entries of an assistant professor)

entries.label: 2026 Jul
entries.text: The lab got funded from the NSF (David’s sole PI; $222,575) to study seafloor basement water-rock interactions (NSF OCE #2617725).

entries.label: 2026 Jun
entries.text: A proposal to study silicic diagenesis was funded ($110,000; no overheads) by the Petroleum Research Fund (American Chemical Society). Contact me if you are motivated to join the group for a MS degree at Western!

entries.label: 2026 Apr
entries.text: Afrid’s first paper got published in the Journal of Volcanology and Geothermal Research! Check some really neat isotope data (triple O, d18O SIMS in quartz, D/H).

entries.label: 2026 Mar
entries.text: I am feeling fortunate to be a co-author on Dr. Steve Kitoga’s wonderful paper on silicified basalts and their contribution to TTG-generating regions, published in Geochemical Perspective Letters.

entries.label: 2025 Dec
entries.text: The lab went to AGU 2025 in New Orleans, LA totaling 3 abstracts. It was nice and warm.

entries.label: 2025 Sept
entries.text: David went to Michigan State University to give the departmental seminar at the EES. Thanks to Dr. Tyrone Rooney for hosting.

entries.label: 2025 Sept
entries.text: Afrid and David went and presented their work at Midwest Geobiology hosted by Purdue University.

entries.label: 2025 Aug
entries.text: Student-led paper fully based on dataset collected in our lab was submitted! Also, we welcome new members of the laboratory — Isabelle Boyer (MS-track) joins the lab from University of Pittsburgh at Johnstown and Andy Smith from Ohio State University (MS-track; co-supervised with Dr. Steve Kaczmarek).

entries.label: 2025 July
entries.text: Zack Stevens graduates with an MS degree! We wish him all the best out west!

entries.label: 2025 July
entries.text: Our new paper on “terribly sick” zircon came out with one of the lowest δ¹⁸Ozc measured (−8 ‰) and its host quartz (−4 ‰) with our brand new triple O-isotope measurements from WMU. Took 5 labs to measure the datasets.

entries.label: 2025 Feb 24–27
entries.text: Afrid Sheik attended the SIMS Workshop 2025 at UCLA.

entries.label: 2024 Dec
entries.text: Our new paper on experimental olivine-water reaction and the corresponding δ′¹⁸O–Δ′¹⁷O shifts came out in Chemical Geology. Warning, there are 15 figures!

entries.label: 2024 Nov 22
entries.text: David gave a seminar at Kellogg Biological Station, MSU. Thanks to Klausmeier-Litchman Lab for hosting.

entries.label: 2024 Oct
entries.text: New paper on silicification of Archean basalts came out in Chemical Geology (Kitoga et al., 2024)! Congrats to Dr. Steve Kitoga with a PhD defense at L'Université Clermont Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand.

entries.label: 2024 Oct 7
entries.text: Our departmental series is hosting Dr. Mattia Pistone (University of Georgia), who will shed light on the drilling project of ICDP in the Ivrea-Verbano zone. Special thanks to the Continental Scientific Drilling program of the Geological Society of America: 2024–2025 Distinguished Lecture series as Mattia is the distinguished lecturer.

entries.label: 2024 Sept
entries.text: Rhys Campbell joined us as an undergraduate researcher continuing the work on petrography and stable isotopes of Michigan basin rocks.

entries.label: 2024 Aug 8–23
entries.text: We present our research at Goldschmidt, 2024 in Chicago! Everyone (Afrid, David and Zack) made their presentations (2 posters, 1 talk) in the session honoring the legacy of Karlis Muehlenbachs.

entries.label: 2024 Apr 24
entries.text: Join the IsoNet Isotopologue Network for Early Career Researchers (ECR) seminar on April 24th. I will be giving a short summary of our research program and lab capabilities.

entries.label: 2024 Apr 11
entries.text: David gives another departmental seminar at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. Thanks to Craig Lundstrom for hosting!

entries.label: 2024 Mar 18
entries.text: We are fortunate to host a Distinguished Lecturer of the Mineralogical Society of America Dr. Juan Carlos de Obeso from University of Utah, who will present his talk “Sparkling water and peridotite: Serpentinization and carbonation in the mantle”.

entries.label: 2024 Mar
entries.text: The fluorination line is working in full swing! First set of consistent high-precision measurements of δ′¹⁸O–Δ′¹⁷O in olivine and quartz was conducted. Get in touch for collaborative projects/service measurements.

entries.label: 2024 Feb 26
entries.text: Our department hosts Dr. Hannah Blatchford (Eastern Michigan University), who will talk about history of deformation and metamorphic petrology in Western Gneiss Region, Norway.

entries.label: 2024 Feb 2
entries.text: David gives a departmental seminar, Smith Lecture at the University of Michigan. Thanks to Ben Passey for hosting!

entries.label: 2024 Jan
entries.text: Marks David’s first year at WMU and the mass spectrometer is at full functionality. Stay tuned for more updates.

entries.label: 2023 Sept 11–14
entries.text: Our Delta V Plus goes through an upgrade.

entries.label: 2023 Sep 8
entries.text: David traveled to the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences, University of Iowa to present the departmental seminar. Thanks to Tom Forster for hosting.

entries.label: 2023 August 15
entries.text: The lab welcomes PhD students Afrid Abdaly Sheik and Zack Stevens.

entries.label: 2023 August 4
entries.text: Renishaw Raman microscope is delivered to David’s lab.

entries.label: 2023 July 9–14
entries.text: David attended Goldschmidt 2023 in Lyon (FR) to present on “Investigating triple O-isotope exchange in submarine vent fluids and experimental H₂O-peridotite reaction” and to chair Session 8eO1 — “How do we reconstruct the environment from the geologic record? Identifying and measuring diagenesis in sedimentary archives”.

entries.label: 2023 June 25–29
entries.text: David attended the 2023 NAGT Early Career Workshop at Macalester College campus. Lots of great networking, community building activities, strategic planning for research and teaching. Highly recommended.

entries.label: 2023 May 4–5
entries.text: North-Central Section GSA meeting in Grand Rapids, MI. David presents “Where water meets magma: A high-temperature record of subaerially exposed continental crust through time”.

entries.label: 2023 May
entries.text: Welcome an undergraduate researcher Evan Angeski! Evan has started learning about the local geology using the drill cores available at the Michigan Geological Repository for Research and Education (MGRRE).

entries.label: 2023 Mar
entries.text: Thermo EA Isolink has arrived on campus!

entries.label: 2023 Feb 7
entries.text: A brand new CO₂ laser arrived along with many bits and pieces of lab equipment.

entries.label: 2023 Jan 9
entries.text: First week of classes at WMU. I am teaching GEOS 1300.

entries.label: 2022 Dec 12–16
entries.text: AGU Fall Meeting 2022 in Chicago! David Zakharov’s first presentation under the “WMU” name tag. The presentation entitled “High-precision and high spatial resolution isotope measurements of seafloor-drilled cherts: What can we learn about diagenesis of ancient cherts?”
